_comment: The research tree, studied in the Scriptorium. Each branch is a short chain: a node needs the one before it (needs), sometimes a Scriptorium level (scriptorium), and for chapter branches a point in the story (when: Story.meets conditions, issue #28) or an open region of the map (region on the branch: the whole branch stays hidden until the chapter opens that region, issue #189). ranks: a study that can be repeated that many times; each rank costs step more than the last and takes days_step more days, and its mods count once per rank. mods: what a node does, by name, summed over everything known (Empire.research_mod): damage, hp (party max HP), guard (share of damage the party no longer takes), revive and power_rate (extra share), ink_regen (extra share), surge_fray (surges hit for this much less), expedition_odds (percent), expedition_slots, envoy_standing (per envoy a day), claim_discount (share off a claim's Gilt), lamp_fray (every Wardlamp slows Fray this much more), calm_region (that region's own pressure stops). Older nodes keep their numbers in scripts/empire.gd (search for the node id). cost is paid once, when you first start the node (Insight, sometimes Ink); days is study time at 100% pace (researchers' Lore speeds it up, see Empire.research_pace). effect is the one-line promise shown on the screen; the numbers themselves live in scripts/empire.gd (search for the node id) so the text and the game stay in step.

branches.name: Wardcraft
branches.blurb: Holding the line against the Blank.

branches.name: Logistics
branches.blurb: Feeding people and moving them about.

branches.name: Inkcraft
branches.blurb: What Ink can do, in the works and in a fight.

branches.name: The Abbey's Learning
branches.blurb: What the brothers of Saint Ledger's know, once they will tell you.

branches.name: Masquerade Arts
branches.blurb: What the Velvet Causeway knows about masks, money and duels.

branches.name: Tide Reckoning
branches.blurb: How the Unfinished Coast lives beside a sea that stopped.

branches.name: The Great Ledger
branches.blurb: The capital's own methods, copied from the margins of the Ledger itself.

nodes.name: Margin Wards
nodes.effect: Every province you hold: Fray -1 a day
nodes.blurb: Little warding scribbles in the margins of every map and deed. The Blank reads the margins first, and it does not like what it finds.

nodes.name: Lampwright's Grammar
nodes.effect: Wardlamps burn brighter: Fray -1 more a day each
nodes.blurb: Lamps that are written as well as lit. The flame spells something; nobody agrees what, but the Blank flinches.

nodes.name: The Long Watch
nodes.effect: Surges are seen 1 day sooner and hit for 8 Fray, not 12
nodes.blurb: A rota of readers who stare at the edge of the white all night and write down when it twitches.

nodes.name: Ration Tables
nodes.effect: Upkeep: 1 less Supplies a day for every 4 people
nodes.blurb: Somebody finally counted the bread. Half the town had been eating twice.

nodes.name: Waystations
nodes.effect: Expeditions come back a quarter sooner
nodes.blurb: Huts, water and a dry blanket a day's walk apart. Squads stop getting lost on the way home.

nodes.name: Field Maps
nodes.effect: Every expedition: +10% success chance
nodes.blurb: Maps that are redrawn every week, because the land keeps changing its mind.

nodes.name: Spring Tapping
nodes.effect: The Inkworks makes +1 Ink a day (while it has a worker); heroes refill Ink 25% faster on missions
nodes.blurb: A better way to draw ink from the springs: slowly, and while humming. The twins insist on the humming.

nodes.name: Blotting Charm
nodes.effect: Missions: downed allies get back up 40% faster
nodes.blurb: A thumbprint of ink on the wrist. Press it to someone who has fallen and they remember they are written down.

nodes.name: Inkskin
nodes.effect: Missions: the party takes 25% less damage
nodes.blurb: Words painted on the skin under the armour. Blank teeth slide off a sentence that refuses to end.

nodes.name: Whetstones
nodes.effect: Missions: the party hits for +2 damage
nodes.blurb: Proper stones, proper oil, and a lecture on angles. Blades stop bouncing off things.

nodes.name: Boiled Leather
nodes.effect: Missions: the party starts with +10 max HP
nodes.blurb: Smells terrible, stops a bite. Everyone gets a jerkin whether they want one or not.

nodes.name: Inked Steel
nodes.effect: Missions: +3 more damage and the attack gauge refills 20% faster
nodes.blurb: Steel quenched in ink instead of water. It comes out black and slightly too eager.

nodes.name: Bell Wards
nodes.effect: Surges hit for 3 less Fray
nodes.blurb: The Abbey's bells were cast with the hours written into the bronze. Rung one at a time, the right hour at the right moment, they make the Blank lose its place.

nodes.name: The Second Copy
nodes.effect: Reclaims cost 1 less Ink and bring a province back at Fray 45, not 60
nodes.blurb: How the monks meant to write the world back if the capital's Ledger burned. It works better on land that was there yesterday.

nodes.name: The Tally of Names
nodes.effect: Every province you hold with a governor: Fray -1 a day
nodes.blurb: Sister Osyth's method: count everyone, by name, and say the number out loud each night. It is very hard to erase something that is being counted.

nodes.name: Beacon Script
nodes.effect: Wardlamps can be raised to level 3: Fray -3 a day, burning 1 Ink a day
nodes.blurb: A lamp that writes its light across the sky in letters three miles high. The Blank reads it from the far edge and keeps its distance.

nodes.name: Readings of the Edge
nodes.effect: Each rank: surges hit for 1 less Fray
nodes.blurb: Night after night, someone sits at the white edge and writes down what it does. The notebooks fill a wall now. The Blank has habits, it turns out.

nodes.name: Relay Riders
nodes.effect: One more expedition can be out at a time
nodes.blurb: Fresh horses at every waystation and riders who sleep in the saddle. Two squads can be fed and found at once.

nodes.name: Quartermaster's Ledgers
nodes.effect: Each rank: every expedition +4% success chance
nodes.blurb: Every expedition that ever went out, what it carried, who came back and why. Read enough of them and you stop packing the wrong rope.

nodes.name: Deep Wells
nodes.effect: Missions: heroes refill Ink 25% faster again
nodes.blurb: The twins found a seam of older ink under the springs. It flows like it remembers being words.

nodes.name: Marginal Inks
nodes.effect: Each rank: missions, the party takes 2% less damage
nodes.blurb: Recipes from the margins of old books: inks for warding, inks for mending, one ink nobody will admit to having made.

nodes.name: Tempered Edges
nodes.effect: Missions: the party hits for +3 damage and starts with +10 max HP
nodes.blurb: Steel folded with a page of the Ledger between each layer. It holds an edge the way a contract holds a debtor.

nodes.name: Drill Manuals
nodes.effect: Each rank: missions, the party hits for +1 damage
nodes.blurb: Every fight the party has survived, drawn out move by move in the margins. Mostly arrows. Some of the arrows are rude.

nodes.name: Masked Envoys
nodes.effect: Every envoy you post: standing +1 more a day
nodes.blurb: Nobody on the Causeway says anything true without a mask on. Your envoys learn to wear one and are suddenly very well liked.

nodes.name: Ink-Lake Charts
nodes.effect: Claiming a province costs 20% less Gilt
nodes.blurb: Charts of the ink lake that show where the deeds are buried. Land is cheaper when you already know who owned it.

nodes.name: Duelling Forms
nodes.effect: Missions: +2 damage and the attack gauge refills 15% faster
nodes.blurb: The bridge duellists fight to first blood, then to the second, then to whoever is still dancing. Their footwork transfers surprisingly well to monsters.

nodes.name: Sea-Walls of Sentences
nodes.effect: The Unfinished Coast stops fraying on its own (its sea pressure ends)
nodes.blurb: A wall of written sentences along the tideline, each one finished properly, full stop and all. The sea remembers where it is supposed to stop.

nodes.name: Wreck Rights
nodes.effect: Every expedition: +10% success chance
nodes.blurb: Salvagers' law, three hundred clauses long. Mostly about who gets the cargo. A little about how everyone gets home.

nodes.name: Unfinished Sentences
nodes.effect: Surges hit for 3 less Fray
nodes.blurb: The coast folk leave every sentence unfinished, so the Blank never knows where one ends and it can start. It is maddening to talk to them. It works.

nodes.name: Errata Slips
nodes.effect: Every Wardlamp: Fray -1 more a day
nodes.blurb: Little slips of correction pasted over the Blank's work, in the Ledger's own hand. Lamplight makes them legible from a long way off.

nodes.name: Countersignatures
nodes.effect: Missions: the party takes 10% less damage
nodes.blurb: Every hero's name, countersigned by a Ledger clerk. Harming a countersigned person is a filing error, and the world hates filing errors.

nodes.name: The Last Word
nodes.effect: Missions: downed allies get back up 40% faster and the party starts with +10 max HP
nodes.blurb: Whoever has the last word in the Ledger is still alive. The scribes write yours in very small letters at the bottom of every page.
